title: Comprehensive Test — Chapters 2.5 & 2.6: Compound and Absolute Value Inequalities

questions.feedbackIfWrong: The correct compound inequality is $ -8 < x \le 4 $.
questions.prompt: Which compound inequality represents 'x is greater than -8 and less than or equal to 4'?
A compound inequality with 'and' is true when a number satisfies ___ of the two inequalities.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: For 'and', the number must satisfy both inequalities.

questions.prompt: Solve $ -4 < x - 2 < 3 $. What is the lower bound?
Solve $ -3 < -2x + 1 \le 9 $. Which is the correct solution?
An 'or' compound inequality is true when a number satisfies at ___ one of the two inequalities.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: At least one of the inequalities must be true.

questions.prompt: Solve $ 3y - 5 < -8 $ or $ 2y - 1 > 5 $. What is the right part's boundary?
Solve $ 5 \le m + 4 < 10 $. What is the solution?
Which compound inequality has no solution?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: $ x > 5 $ and $ x < 2 $ has no overlap, so no solution.

questions.prompt: A smartphone operates from 0°C to 35°C. Using $ C = \frac{5}{9}(F - 32) $, the Fahrenheit operating range is $ 32 \le F \le $ ___.
Solve $ 2r + 3 < 7 $ or $ -r + 9 \le 2 $. What is the right part's solution? (e.g., r >= 7)
The absolute value inequality $ |x| < 2 $ is equivalent to:
questions.feedbackIfWrong: $ |x| < 2 $ means $ -2 < x < 2 $, which is $ x > -2 $ and $ x < 2 $.

questions.prompt: The inequality $ |x| > 4 $ is equivalent to the compound inequality $ x < -4 $ ___ $ x > 4 $.
Solve $ |x + 7| \le 2 $. What is the solution?
Solve $ |c - 1| \ge 5 $. What is the left boundary of the 'or' solution? (e.g., -4)
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The left part is $ c \le -4 $, so the boundary is -4.
$ |x| < -3 $ has no solution because absolute value cannot be less than a negative number.
questions.prompt: Which absolute value inequality has no solution?
If $ |ax + b| > c $ and $ c < 0 $, the solution is ___ real numbers.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: First isolate the absolute value: subtract 1, then divide by 4.
questions.prompt: What is the first step to solve $ 4|2x - 5| + 1 > 21 $?
After isolating in $ 3|d + 1| - 7 \ge -1 $, what is the resulting absolute value inequality? (e.g., |d+1| >= 2)
What is the solution of $ |10 - m| \ge -2 $?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: All real numbers are solutions because absolute value is never less than -2.

questions.prompt: The absolute deviation inequality $ |x - 664| \le 100 $ means that $ x $ is at ___ 100 units away from 664.

Solve $ -4|6b - 8| \le 12 $. After dividing by -4, what is the resulting inequality?
In the blueprint for absolute value inequalities, the Solve phase for $ |ax + b| < c $ involves writing a three-part inequality: $ -c < ax + b < c $, which is an '___' compound inequality.
